items.summary: Tech stocks coverage for the week of Aug. 3.

overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 70.71% annualised against 23.91% volatility (Sharpe 2.17) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 38.7%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.43% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.03% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -13.13%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 2.09%, 99% VaR 17.61%, CVaR 95% 11.50%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.69%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-73.40% return, max drawdown -76.19%, worst day -20.48%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 26.25% vs realised 26.02% — vol regime rising.

liquidity.commentary: AUM $1,000,000 across 5 positions. The most concentrated trade is WFC at 0.0% of 30-day ADV. At a 20% participation rate, the slowest unwind would be WFC at 0.0 trading days — manageable but worth keeping in mind for any rapid de-risk. Kelly divergence > 10pp on CVX: current sizing is materially out of step with Kelly — review whether that reflects intentional risk budgeting or stale weights.
